name: strategic-operator
description: Open-source Claude skills for Biz Ops, Strategy, Program Management, and Communications.

plugins.name: bizops
plugins.description: Run the business: operating rhythm, planning and OKRs, metrics, processes, vendors, compliance, and meetings that actually decide things.

plugins.name: discovery
plugins.description: Continuous customer discovery: interview design, transcript synthesis, JTBD workshops, opportunity ideation, and the disciplines that keep discovery signal over noise.

plugins.name: positioning
plugins.description: Decide where to play and how to win: market frameworks (Porter's, SWOT, Ansoff), business-model canvases, ICP, and go-to-market strategy.

plugins.name: product-planning
plugins.description: Turn strategy into product direction: PRDs, product vision, prioritization frameworks, and outcome-driven roadmaps.

plugins.name: programs
plugins.description: Deliver cross-functional work: programs and portfolios, launches, dependencies, decisions, risk, agile delivery, and the tools teams run on.

plugins.name: operating-model
plugins.description: Design how a team runs: the operating model itself, decision rights, governance forums, and OKRs. For teams with no existing process to inherit.

plugins.name: portfolio
plugins.description: Run a portfolio: intake, scoring against declared criteria, whole-portfolio health, and matching demand against real capacity.

plugins.name: intelligence
plugins.description: Build a standing market intelligence function: ecosystem mapping, partner scans, competitive reads, and a recurring signals brief.

plugins.name: communications
plugins.description: Turn any analysis into something an audience can act on: slide decks built from a fixed slide grammar, rendered from markdown, shaped differently for executives, the internal team, and external stakeholders.
